enabled.title: Enabled

apiBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the KernelScan API.

apiKey.description: KernelScan account API key (`ks_live_…`). The analyzer resolves the product matching the analyzed kernel version and reports that product's config-aware finding set.

cacheMinutes.title: Cache (minutes)
